note.text: DASH (Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder and Hand) score: 68/100 indicating severe disability. Patient unable to perform overhead work or lift objects greater than 2 lbs. Activities of daily living significantly limited: unable to dress independently, difficulty with personal hygiene. Occupational function severely compromised.
Full-thickness supraspinatus tear with medial retraction 1.5 cm. Moderate tendon degeneration. No evidence of rotator cuff atrophy.

Patient completed a 14-week physical therapy course for right shoulder pain and weakness (January through April 2026). Treatment included rotator cuff strengthening, scapular stabilization, and manual therapy. Outcome at 14 weeks: persistent weakness and pain, no functional improvement. Conservative management deemed unsuccessful. Note: patient also received 2 corticosteroid injections during this period; see Observation/steroid-injection-007 for injection records.
